text: 当地时间9月3日，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在符拉迪沃斯托克同俄罗斯第一副总理曼图罗夫共同主持中俄投资合作委员会第十三次会议。
text_en: On September 3 local time, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, co-chaired the 13th meeting of the China-Russia Investment Cooperation Committee in Vladivostok with Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Manturov.
